row.title: Branch sweep must finish inside its job
row.body: branchsweep ran the full gate after every merge; with ~100 branches the pass outran its 15-minute job and was cancelled with nothing pushed (2026-11-18), and branches already filed as PORT items were re-gated every pass. SWEEP-BUDGET-1: a 600 s budget per pass records the rest as skipped, filed ports are not re-gated, a later pass continues the open sweep branch, and the workflow re-dispatches itself while branches remain (at most 8 runs a day).

title: Branch sweep must finish inside its job
